result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section right after "Longest Duplicates", and its code fragments are saved when `saveCodeFragments` is on. The `codeanalyzer` duplication analyzer test passes, and the `reports` module compiles. I did not run the report end to end, and `reports` has no tests covering this code.

Changes, uncommitted:

- **`DuplicationReportGenerator.java`**: calls the existing `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList`, which was never invoked. The section is skipped when the list is empty. Its description and table come from the existing helper.
- **`DataExporter.java`**: saves the most frequent duplicates as `fragments/most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>`, alongside the longest and unit duplicates.
- **`DuplicationAnalyzer.java`**: fixed a bug in `addMostFrequentDuplicates`. It sorted a throwaway copy and then took the first N entries of the unsorted list, so the stored "most frequent" duplicates were not the most frequent. It now sorts a copy and takes the top N from that. This is a small change beyond the report and export, but without it the new section would show the wrong duplicates.

I did not add the most-frequent duplicates' files to the referenced-files set used for source-file links. Unit duplicates are not in that set either, so the Files column may show names without links. Say if you want that added.
